Hoy lleve mi auto a BOXES y pedi servicio premium.  Al retirar la persona que se encargó del trabajo me dijo que NO hizo el scann que yo solicité porque vio que en el tablero no indicaba nada “raro”.  Pero más allá de eso yo pedí ese scann.  No obstante en el informe final aparecen resultados del scann como si lo hubieran hecho.  Me genera mucha desconfianza esta situación.  No recomiendo BOXES YPF.

(Translated by Google)
Today I took my car to BOXES and requested premium service. When I picked it up, the person who did the work told me he didn't do the scan I requested because he saw nothing "unusual" on the dashboard. But I specifically asked for the scan. However, the final report shows scan results as if they had done it. This situation makes me very suspicious. I do not recommend BOXES YPF.
